events.OracleCheckChoiceSelected: User selects existing oracle or become-oracle path
events.OracleAnnouncementSelected: User selects a specific oracle announcement
events.OracleCheckContinued: User continues past oracle check step
events.OutcomeTypeSelected: User selects Yes/No, Categorical, or Numeric market type
events.BasicInfoUpdated: User updates title, categories, or closing date
events.ThumbnailUploaded: User uploads a market thumbnail image
events.OutcomeAdded: User adds a new outcome to the market
events.OutcomeRemoved: User removes an outcome from the market
events.OutcomeUpdated: User updates an outcome label or probability
events.NumericBoundsUpdated: User updates numeric market LO/HI bounds, precision, or unit
events.LiquiditySatsUpdated: User updates the initial liquidity amount
events.MarketCreated: User submits the market for creation
events.WizardExited: User exits the wizard (back to dashboard or settings)

currentState.currentStep: Current step in the 6-step wizard (1=Oracle Check, 2=Get Started, 3=Basic Info, 4=Outcomes, 5=Initial Liquidity, 6=Review)
currentState.stepOracleCheck: Oracle check step data (choice and selected announcement)
currentState.stepGetStarted: Get started step data (outcome type selection: yesno, categorical, or numeric)
currentState.stepBasicInfo: Basic info step data (title, categories, closing date)
currentState.stepOutcomes: Outcomes step data (outcome type, outcome definitions, or numeric bounds)
currentState.stepInitialLiquidity: Initial liquidity step data (sats amount to seed the market)
